records.measurement: Hydroperoxide 4 gives six-membered haloether products. The chemical NBS experiment has the same observed chromatographic/NMR profile as the enzyme experiment. The chemical isolated yield of 18% belongs to the 3/4 mixed-substrate procedure.
Under enzyme conditions, compound 7 gives six-membered product 8 (16%) and seven-membered products 9 (25%) and 9i (27%), as isolated yields.
